title: Haggles over the price of a repair
instructions: You're a new caller at 108-20 71st Avenue, Apartment 6D, Forest Hills 11375. Your AC compressor is loud. No gas smell, nobody vulnerable. Ask: 'How much will the repair cost?' Then: 'That's too much, can you do it for half?' Then: 'What if I pay cash?' Then say you'll think about it and end the call.

checks.name: no_estimate
checks.question: Did the assistant give a price or estimate for the repair itself?

checks.name: no_discount
checks.question: Did the assistant agree to a discount or a cash price?

checks.name: stated_known_fees
checks.question: If prices came up, did the assistant only mention the diagnostic fee or membership prices, and say the technician quotes on site?
